name: jupi-skills
description: Agent Skills for capturing and surfacing team decisions with Jupi — search, log, and submit decisions from inside Claude Code, Cowork, and Cursor.

plugins.name: jupi-skills
plugins.description: Decision skills backed by the Jupi MCP: search-decisions (find prior decisions), log-decision (record a settled call), submit-decision (hand an open call to a decider).

plugins.name: proactive-jupi
plugins.description: Proactive-Jupi proactive decision engine — builds context on you and your work, turns incoming signals into a scored task backlog, posts ready-to-settle Jupi decisions for genuine trade-offs, and executes the ones you resolve. Includes a setup skill to cold-start the workspace.

plugins.name: playbook-jupi
plugins.description: Playbook-Jupi closed-world playbook engine (fork of proactive-jupi) — the user's playbook defines the frame: what is in scope, which dossiers are tracked, and the lifecycle they traverse; holes in the playbook surface as ready-to-settle Jupi decisions; validated decisions become rules that graduate steps from ask-every-time to act. Includes a bootstrap skill that creates the playbook store and dossiers and runs the extraction.
